One child in a floral dress picks up a small wooden box while another child in polka dots walks nearby. (2) The child in the floral dress holds a brown plush lion toy and carefully places it into a wooden container on the floor. An adult's hand points toward a toy drawer. (3) The child stands before a colorful ball drop tower, holding an orange ball. She then moves to a wooden shelf filled with toys and plushies to organize items. (4) The child picks up a large yellow plush toy shaped like a fry or corn. She carries it across the room toward a miniature toy kitchen set under the window. (5) At the toy kitchen, she places the yellow toy on the stove surface. She looks at the camera and starts clapping her hands with a proud expression. (6) The child sits on the floor next to a ginger tabby cat. She interacts with a small toy piano while the adult speaks off-camera.
